caption: #1667: a deep Infantry block (3 files x 20 ranks) facing north beside the hill is side-stepped east six times. The first two steps are clear; the third is pulled back so the block's rear ranks stop at the hill's edge instead of entering it; for the last three the block already stands at the edge, so each is clamped to within 1 wu of where it stands and the block stays put. No soldier ends up inside the hill; with the clamp reverted, 21 do (ticks 392, 480 and 600).
